instruction: A candid wide-angle documentary photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, extending his right hand to touch the cheek of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left and looking directly at him. The scene is illuminated by even overhead indoor lighting, creating a neutral color palette with soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R1 extends his right hand to touch R2's cheek
R2 is the person whose cheek is being touched by R1
R1 initiates the face contact rather than R2 touching R1's face
